## Core Summary
Chibueze Aniezeofor, widely known online as **codad5** (or `codad5_`), is a top-tier software engineer with over 6 years of experience building high-performance backend systems, distributed architectures, developer tooling, and AI-integrated platforms.

- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki.

- **Specializations**: Backend Systems Architecture, API Design (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), Performance Optimization, Open-Source Tooling, AI Integration (LLM integrations, agentic workflows).
